answer_1.quote: We test our proposed technique on two knowledgegrounded dialogue generation benchmark datasets, viz. Wizard of Wikipedia and CMU Document Grounded Conversations.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the predicted responses, we choose BLEU , PPL, F1 and Embedding-based metrics.

answer_4.quote: We hire four professionals, each with a postgraduate degree and experience, to serve as human judgment annotators. We use the following metrics for evaluation: (i) Fluency, (ii) Adequacy, (iii) Knowledge Existence, (iv) Knowledge Correctness, (v) Knowledge Relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators score responses on fluency, adequacy, knowledge existence, knowledge correctness, and knowledge relevance.
